description: Undo the last kill switch press: give every token it suspended its previous expiry back and unpause AI (unless AI was already paused before the press, which stays as it was). A press already undone, or none at all, is a precondition failure. Site admins with an admin-scoped token only. Audit-logged (security.kill_switch.undo); every site admin is alerted. Mirrors POST /api/v2/admin/security/kill-switch/undo. Returns {pressedAt, undoneAt, ofSuspended, restored, aiUnpaused, aiWasPaused, effect}.
name: merjax_undo_kill_switch
